svg.text: What is where on the frame
Front view of the finished machine (2019). Relay CPU in the middle, silicon periphery on top.
IP, AP, CMD and retired-instruction counter (ATmega168 each)
64K×16 SRAM + ATmega loader, 32×16 LED view of RAM
RES43 relays route data between blocks
16-bit adder with parallel carry, TMP/CMD and IP/AP registers
impulse sequencer + decoder; one slot kept free for expansion
5 relay blocks × 32 modules · 3–4 reed relays per module
each block is powered from 5 V / 3 A
